description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Floor Area: 65 square metres of open, ambient floor space, ideal for group sessions or large-scale auditions.
  • Ultra-Low Noise Floor: Engineered for quiet with a noise floor of just 15 dBA, ensuring pristine acoustic conditions for audio recording, music auditions, or sound-sensitive activities.
  • Group Capacity: Accommodates up to 24 people comfortably, making it suitable for ensemble rehearsals, workshops, or collaborative projects.
  • Session Duration: Each booking allows for a 4-hour session, providing ample time for thorough auditions, rehearsals, or extended creative work.
  • Custom Session Fee: Pricing is determined after acceptance, allowing for flexible, needs-based cost structures tailored to your project.
  • Mass Wall Isolation: Advanced sound isolation using mass wall construction effectively blocks external noise and prevents sound leakage, supporting professional-grade audio work.

Main Benefits

  • Exceptional Acoustic Environment: The combination of low noise floor and mass wall isolation creates an optimal setting for critical listening, recording, or performance, addressing common concerns about external noise and audio clarity.
  • Flexible and Scalable Space: The large area and high occupancy limit suit a variety of group sizes and activities, from solo artists to full ensembles.
  • Convenient Booking Terms: Four-hour sessions provide the time needed for comprehensive work without frequent interruptions, while custom pricing ensures you only pay for what you need.
  • Reliable Privacy and Security: The robust isolation method ensures privacy for confidential auditions or sensitive recordings, a frequent requirement for professionals in music, film, or broadcasting.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Professional Auditions: Ideal for casting calls, music auditions, and talent screenings where acoustic quality and privacy are paramount.
  • Recording Sessions: Suited for bands, choirs, or audio engineers seeking a quiet, interference-free environment for high-fidelity sound recording.
  • Workshops and Rehearsals: Perfect for group rehearsals, workshops, or creative collaborations that require both space and sound isolation.
  • Product Testing: Excellent for testing audio equipment, microphones, or other sound-sensitive devices in a controlled environment.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the space easy to book? Yes, sessions are available in 4-hour blocks, with fees set after your needs are assessed.
  • Is it suitable for large groups? Yes, the venue can comfortably host up to 24 people.
  • How is noise controlled? A mass wall isolation system and a 15 dBA noise floor ensure minimal external sound intrusion.
  • Can I use my own equipment? The space is compatible with a wide range of audio and recording equipment, supporting diverse project requirements.

This ambient-floor audition vault offers a quiet, spacious, and versatile environment tailored to the needs of audio professionals, performers, and creative teams seeking premium acoustic conditions and flexible booking options.
